scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a summer Niagara Falls visit, [X] separates ordinary viewpoints and gorge walking from the boat and near-falls platforms where ponchos leave feet exposed, deciding whether to block prolonged spray or deliberately accept soaking in a grippy, draining shoe category.
examples: using Waterproof when keeping socks dry through repeated spray matters most
using Water Resistant only for brief mist or ordinary viewpoints
using Not Waterproof positively for water shoes or sandals when soaking, drainage, grip, and quick drying are expected
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 夏季前往尼亚加拉瀑布前，[X]会把普通观景与峡谷步行，同游船和近瀑平台上雨披遮不住双脚的活动分开，判断应阻挡持续水雾，还是在有抓地力且能排水的鞋履类别中主动接受浸湿。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While finalizing a solo seven-day Maui packing list, [X] assigns separate footwear roles to snorkeling and reef entry, valley or trail walking, historical sites, and resort time, deciding which category may be immersed and drain quickly and which must stay comfortable for dry mileage.
examples: using Not Waterproof water shoes or reef sandals for deliberate immersion and drainage
using Water Resistant for a walking role exposed only to short splashes or showers
keeping the main dry-mileage shoe out of the ocean instead of pretending one category handles every role
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 完成独自七天毛伊岛行程的打包清单时，[X]会为浮潜与礁石入水、山谷或小径步行、历史景点及度假村活动分别安排不同鞋款，判断哪一类可以浸水并快速排干，哪一类必须为干燥路程保持舒适。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For the full Camino Frances in winter, [X] prepares one primary footwear category and balances weeks of rain, snow, ice, and mud against sweat, blisters, traction, daily distance, sparse hostel drying, and the cost of replacing failed footwear en route.
examples: using Waterproof for persistent cold precipitation when no dry backup is available
using Water Resistant when mixed conditions favor modest shedding with less heat and bulk
using Not Waterproof trail footwear only when ventilation and overnight drying are an intentional blister-control strategy
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为冬季走完整条法国之路准备主要鞋履类别时，[X]会在数周雨雪、结冰和泥泞，与出汗、水泡、抓地、每日里程、青旅干燥条件不足以及途中更换成本之间做取舍。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an Italian summer trip, [X] compares a washable foam sandal that tolerates getting wet with breathable leather sandals and canvas sneakers while accounting for foot sweat, cobblestones, long walks, appearance, sustainable materials, and delivery to Ireland.
examples: using Waterproof when a foam sandal must tolerate pool or beach wetting without damage
using Not Waterproof leather or canvas when breathability and lower sweat dominate dry city walking
not treating a retailer description as a purchased pair or verified field outcome
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季行程准备鞋履时，[X]会比较可水洗、耐浸湿的泡沫凉鞋与更透气的皮凉鞋和帆布运动鞋，同时考虑脚汗、石板路、长距离步行、外观、可持续材质及向爱尔兰发货。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While taking a budget highway-bus loop from Tokyo through Kanazawa, Shirakawa-go, and Takayama in mid-April with a family of four, [X] prepares the children's footwear for sloped village walks, festival crowds, rain, and patches of melting snow, carrying spare socks and avoiding thin sandals.
examples: using Water Resistant sturdy sneakers for intermittent rain, puddles, and shallow slush
using Waterproof only if the near-departure forecast shows sustained cold wet conditions
retaining spare socks because limited protection does not eliminate every puddle mistake
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 四月中旬与一家四口乘长途巴士从东京前往金泽、白川乡和高山时，[X]会为孩子准备适合坡路、节庆人群、降雨及残留融雪的鞋履，同时携带备用袜子并避开轻薄凉鞋。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a self-drive summer waterfall and hiking trip in Mpumalanga, [X] chooses between light hiking boots and trail runners for hot humid days with frequent afternoon thunderstorms, slippery paths, waterfall pools, and gear that may remain damp for hours.
examples: using Waterproof when repeated storms and cold wet feet outweigh ventilation
using Water Resistant for brief showers when low weight and trail comfort remain equally important
using Not Waterproof only when pool entry or unavoidable soaking makes drainage and fast drying more useful than sealing
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为姆普马兰加夏季自驾瀑布徒步行程准备鞋履时，[X]会在轻型徒步靴与越野跑鞋之间选择，以应对炎热潮湿、频繁午后雷雨、湿滑小径、瀑布水潭以及装备数小时不易干燥的情况。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After keeping a five-day Cape Town trip in June, [X] revises the footwear category around winter rain, city streets, botanical paths, exposed mountain areas, coastal drives, indoor backups, and a limited luggage budget rather than assuming every outdoor day will proceed.
examples: using Waterproof when the outdoor itinerary must continue through sustained winter rain
using Water Resistant when the traveler will wait out heavy weather and cross only short showers
using Not Waterproof only when outdoor days can be rescheduled around dry windows and indoor activities dominate
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 仍选择六月去开普敦五天后，[X]会围绕冬雨、城市街道、植物园小径、暴露山地、海岸自驾、室内备选和有限行李预算调整鞋履类别，而不是假设所有户外日程都会照常进行。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After buying a brown dress for a garden wedding, [X] searches for white shoes that will not pinch wide feet, sink into soft ground, or be easily marked by damp grass and soil, comparing cleanability and limited weather protection without claiming that a candidate pair has been bought or field-tested.
examples: using Water Resistant leather or synthetic uppers for dew, light showers, and grass marks
using Not Waterproof delicate dress materials only when the forecast is dry and appearance dominates
keeping toe room and stable ground contact in the decision rather than optimizing water behavior alone
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为花园婚礼买下棕色连衣裙后，[X]会寻找不会夹宽脚、陷入松软地面或轻易被湿草和泥土弄脏的白鞋，并比较易清洁性和有限防水能力，但不虚构已购买或实地测试候选鞋。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For four winter days in Tromso covering aurora watching, a fjord outing, reindeer activity, and snowshoeing, [X] allocates a warm boot category to long low-movement nights and repeated snow or slush exposure while keeping warmth, traction, sock room, and cost distinct from water protection.
examples: using Waterproof for repeated snow and slush during long cold waits
using Water Resistant only when exposure is brief and heated indoor recovery is frequent
not treating waterproofing as a substitute for insulation, grip, or proper fit
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划在特罗姆瑟度过四个冬日，安排极光守候、峡湾活动、驯鹿体验和雪鞋行走时，[X]会为长时间低活动量夜间与反复雪水接触准备一类保暖靴，同时把保温、抓地、厚袜空间和成本与防水性能分开考虑。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a weekend mountain climb with friends, [X] packs familiar hiking shoes and observes the same pair through rugged ascent, spray at a waterfall, steeper slopes, summit time, and descent, using sock dampness, water entry, grip, and after-trip drying to judge protection without inventing a membrane or rating.
examples: using observed dryness through repeated spray as evidence for stronger protection
using partial wetting after brief spray as limited resistance rather than full waterproofing
using drainage and recovery only if the familiar pair actually becomes wet
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与朋友进行周末登山时，[X]会装入熟悉的徒步鞋，并在崎岖上坡、瀑布飞溅、更陡坡面、山顶停留和下坡过程中观察同一双鞋，再根据袜子潮湿、水分进入、抓地和回家后的干燥情况判断其防护能力，同时不虚构鞋膜或等级。
